rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. The child follows its distinctive sequence: declare responsibility or policy against discrimination; establish a presidential committee; authorize that committee on behalf of the President to examine agency rules, procedures, and practices for possible improvement; direct consultation and recommendations; and require government-wide cooperation and information. Several clauses are closely preserved while the target shifts from equality within the armed services to nondiscrimination by government contractors. C06 and C21 share committee machinery, but their parallels are less extensive and less distinctive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Committee on Government Contract Compliance... Six other members... shall be designated by the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There shall be created... the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services, which shall be composed of seven members to be designated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish a presidentially designated committee as the central implementation mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee is authorized on behalf of the President to examine and study the rules, procedures, and practices of the contracting agencies... in order to determine in what respects such rules, procedures, and practices may be strengthened and improved.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Committee is authorized on behalf of the President to examine into the rules, procedures and practices of the armed services in order to determine in what respect such rules, procedures and practices may be altered or improved
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, closely shared language defining substantially the same investigatory function, adapted to contracting agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee shall confer and advise with the appropriate officers... and... may make... recommendations which in the judgment of the Committee will prevent or eliminate discrimination.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Committee shall confer and advise with the Secretary of Defense... and shall make such recommendations... as in the judgment of the Committee will effectuate the policy hereof.
shared_material.explanation: The consultation-and-recommendation provision preserves the parent's operative structure and phrasing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All contracting agencies of the Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee and... to furnish the Committee such information and assistance as it may require
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee in its work, and to furnish the Committee such information... as the Committee may require
shared_material.explanation: The cooperation clause is nearly literal and completes the same sequence of administrative machinery.
